_readme: Human-in-the-loop curation layer. Always wins over auto-classification.
collections: featured rails shown above the grid (ordered videoIds you pick).
curatedOverrides: per-videoId partial VideoEntry to fix topics/level/etc.
hidden: videoIds to exclude from the library (low quality, off-topic, outdated).
summaries: our own short summary per videoId — ORIGINAL words only, never a copied YouTube description.
